objects.description: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) has used net group /domain, net group “domain admins” /domain, and net group “Exchange Trusted Subsystem” /domain to find domain group permission settings.(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig May 2016)
